title: Speaking — Markets
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on markets.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
Do you visit street markets or indoor markets?
What type of goods do you associate with markets?

part2.topic: Describe a market you think a visitor would enjoy.
part2.closing: and explain why you would take a visitor there.

questions: What can markets offer local producers that large supermarkets cannot?
How should councils decide whether to preserve a historic market?
How has everyday life connected with markets changed for people of different ages?
